ui.foot: Iithambhineyili zikawonke-wonke ze-YouTube kuphela. Akukho iiakhawunti, akukho ukukhuphela ividiyo, akukho ukulandelela ii-URL ezincanyathelisiweyo.
ui.heroIntro: Khuphela iithambhineyili ze-YouTube ne-ngokukhawuleza ngomgangatho ophezulu ofumanekayo, simahla. Khupha uze ugcine imifanekiso ye-HD kuyo nayiphi ividiyo ye-YouTube kawonke-wonke, i-Shorts okanye i-URL ye-ngokucofa kanye. Ncamathisela ikhonkco ngezantsi, cofa Fumana ithambhineyili, uze ukhuphele okanye wabelane ngekhonkco elilungileyo.
